reference_provenance.subject: ashtusk
reference_provenance.prompt: Create a material-only Ashtusk reference from the supplied full Tuskroot studio image, using the supplied existing Ashtusk board solely for its established ash/basalt/ember palette and variant identity. Preserve EXACTLY the Tuskroot image's body geometry, boar proportions, rounded expressive face, brows, snout, ears, two curved tusks, layered stone back, all four legs and complete feet, small tail, pose, camera, framing, studio floor and lighting. Ashtusk is the SAME Tuskroot body as an aspect variant, never a new mesh or armour redesign. Recolour warm brown fur to deep natural ash brown and soot-dark highlights while retaining visible fur direction; recolour the existing grey stone plates to rough charcoal basalt with a few large thin warm orange/amber ember cracks mainly in plate seams. Recolour the existing moss/leaf surface groups to scorched dark brown/ash without changing or removing their geometry. The two existing tusks retain their exact ivory tusk shape but have darkened basalt surfaces with sparse restrained warm orange ember veins; preserve readable curved silhouettes. Eyes remain expressive with warm amber/orange irises and visible dark pupils, not featureless glowing spheres. Keep nose and nostrils dark and clear. No overall body emission, no body engulfed in flames, no smoke cloud hiding form, no lava wash or red faction colour. Soft roughness on fur and stone; no metallic or plastic sheen. No changes to anatomy, silhouette, facial proportions, foot count, body size, new horns, claws, spikes, scars, equipment, saddle, harness, background or props. One complete existing Ashtusk aspect-variant boar in the same plain light-grey studio scene, no text, labels, board or alternate views. The board is a palette guide, not permission to copy its angular armour geometry.
